summary: Plaintiffs raised fees in their opening proposals, and fees were negotiated alongside class relief before the final class fund was settled. The transcript links fee treatment to class value through provisions sending unawarded fees to the class, and plaintiff private reasoning considered firm compensation. The defense selected among overlapping counsel based on lowest total outlay, supporting reverse-auction tactics, but the transcript does not clearly show plaintiffs sacrificing class relief for fees or a misleading court declaration.
